content: अगाध {%a.%} [गाध्--प्रतिष्ठायां घञ्; <sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] Unfathomable, very deep, bottomless; अगाधसलिलात्समुद्रात् <ls>H. 1. 52</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab>) profound, sound, very deep, यस्य ज्ञानदयासिन्धोरगाधस्यानघा गुणाः <ls>Ak.</ls> unfathomable, incomprehensible, inscrutable, Not learned; अगाधाश्चाप्रतिष्ठाश्च गतिमन्तश्च नारद <ls>Mb. 12. 286. 7</ls> Not established, well-known; अगाधजन्मामरणं च राजन् <ls>Mb. 12. 308. 39</ls>. .{@-धः, -धम्@} a deep hole or chasm. .{@-धः@} <ab>N.</ab> of one of the 5 fires at the स्वाहाकार [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Gr.</lang> {%agathos%}].
